events.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
X=pd.read_csv('sample.swap.rna.q2.tsv.gz',sep='\\t',index_col=0)
D=pd.read_csv('wheat_root_atlas/conserved_marker_analysis/input/tae_log2FC0.5_FDR0.05.csv')
# specificity within pseudobulk, log2 fold versus median other cols
L=np.log2(X+1)
Z=L.sub(L.mean(1),axis=0).div(L.std(1).replace(0,np.nan),axis=0)
R=L.rank(axis=1,pct=True)
for n in [10,25,50,100,99999]:
 print('\\nN',n)
 out=[]
 for cl,g in D.groupby('cluster',sort=True):
  genes=[x for x in g.sort_values(['avg_log2FC','p_val_adj'],ascending=[False,True])['gene ID'].drop_duplicates() if x in X.index][:n]
  sc=Z.loc[genes].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)
  out.append([cl,len(genes),sc.index[0],sc.iloc[0],sc.index[1],sc.iloc[1]])
 print(pd.DataFrame(out,columns=['cluster','ng','best','score','second','score2']).to_string(index=False))
# detailed N=50
M={}
for cl,g in D.groupby('cluster'):
 genes=[x for x in g.sort_values('avg_log2FC',ascending=False)['gene ID'].drop_duplicates() if x in X.index][:50]
 M[cl]=Z.loc[genes].mean()
print('\\nZ scores top50')
print(pd.DataFrame(M).T.round(2).to_string())
PY"
